dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good evening. Can I take your order?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈiːvnɪŋ. kən aɪ ˈteɪk jʊr ˈɔːrdər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not yet. What do you recommend?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. ˈwʌt duː juː ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Our specialty is green curry. I recommend trying it.
dialogue.reading: aʊr ˈspɛʃəlti ɪz ˈɡriːn ˈkɜːri. aɪ ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ˈtraɪɪŋ ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, I'll have the green curry for my main course.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, aɪl ˈhæv ðə ˈɡriːn ˈkɜːri fər maɪ ˈmeɪn ˈkɔːrs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And what do you suggest for an appetizer?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt duː juː səɡˈdʒɛst fər ən ˈæpɪtaɪzər?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I suggest ordering the fish cakes. They're very popular.
dialogue.reading: aɪ səɡˈdʒɛst ˈɔːrdərɪŋ ðə ˈfɪʃ ˈkeɪks. ðɛr ˈvɛri ˈpɑːpjələr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. We'll share them. And I'll have the chicken and rice.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. wiːl ˈʃɛr ðɛm. ənd aɪl ˈhæv ðə ˈtʃɪkən ənd ˈraɪs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, please! What do you recommend?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz! ˈwʌt duː juː ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I recommend trying the coconut ice cream. It's made here.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ˈtraɪɪŋ ðə ˈkoʊkənʌt ˈaɪs ˈkriːm. ɪts ˈmeɪd ˈhɪr.
